Your company offers you ₹10 lakh worth of ESOPs. But does that mean you actually have ₹10 lakh in your pocket? Not quite!
In this video, Aastha Khurana explains what ESOPs are, how they work and what you should know before considering them part of your compensation. Understand the basics of ESOPs so you know what your company is really offering you.
